GENERATE BURST K1p-sig-01 — the Keeper advanced-set provenance mark 'Needle through Strata' (ledger R-32): TWO candidate glyph templates. task_id "K1p-sig-01".

Make TWO separate image_gen calls, each producing: a single flat game INSIGNIA emblem, centred, filling about 60 % of the canvas height, on a flat uniform pure #00ff00 background: ONE vertical needle / gnomon with a small diamond-shaped head and a short foot, piercing THREE stacked horizontal strata bands — the lowest band widest, the middle band narrower, the top band narrowest; brass with a confident dark contour line; TWO tones only (a brass fill and a darker brass shade) plus the dark line; no enclosing ring, shield, frame or border; no text, letters, numbers, clock, hourglass, compass, gears, stars or wings; bold simple shapes that stay legible when shrunk to 8 pixels tall; hand-drawn painted 2D game-art line quality (tapered dark contour), no photographic rendering, no bevel, no glow, no shadow. Candidate A: the needle is a slim straight shaft and the strata are straight-edged bands with small gaps between them. Candidate B: the needle is slightly thicker with the diamond head wider than the shaft, and the strata bands touch each other with gently rounded ends. Square canvas.

ONE extra retry only if a result has a baked checkerboard, text, a ring/frame, or is off-plate — name the reason. Copy the outputs from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/glyph_A.png and out/glyph_B.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1p-sig-01"; images = both files with prompt and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
